The '''WSB-15 sabotage droid''' was a [[Class four droid/Legends|fourth-degree]] military [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model physically identical to the [[WED Treadwell repair droid/Legends|WED Treadwell repair droid]]. Along with sharing all the [[Class five droid/Legends|fifth-degree]] [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell's]] systems and abilities, the WSB-15's differences from the latter included having a [[Heuristic processor/Legends|heuristic processor]], military-grade sabotage and [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] use [[Programmer/Legends|programming]], and a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct system unit]]. With most WSB-15 sabotage droids simply being WED-15 Treadwells with different [[Processor/Legends|processors]], uses for the former included reprogramming droid [[Factory/Legends|factories]] to produce droids with very different personalities and training than intended, creating serious [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] malfunctions that would only show up in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] or engaging in wanton destruction sprees.

In some cases, a WSB-15 would successfully perform its sabotage activities until discovered and then destroy itself. In other cases, a WSB-15 would instead fake a minor malfunction, which would then allow its owner to discretely arrange its processing core to be swapped with a normal WED-15 unit's. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[WED-15-I7]] was a WSB-15 that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:WEDtreadwell-NEGTD.png|thumb|left|250px|A WED-15 Treadwell, which WSB-15 sabotage droids were visually identical to]]
The WSB-15 [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was a [[Class four droid/Legends|fourth degree]] droid that cost 13,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for military purchase. It was physically identical to the [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]], a [[Class five droid/Legends|class five droid]] with a basic [[Processor/Legends|processor]] which functioned as a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]]. Along with having all of the WED-15 Treadwell's systems and abilities, the WSB-15 sabotage droid also had a [[Heuristic processor/Legends|heuristic processor]], military-grade sabotage and [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] use [[Programmer/Legends|programming]], and a small [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct system unit]] attached to the processor. Most WSB-15 sabotage droids were simply WED-15 Treadwells with a different processor. WSB-15s could also understand the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Binary/Legends|Binary]] [[Language/Legends|languages]] and possessed low-light vision.<ref name="Threats" />

A WSB-15 additionally contained a tracked [[Locomotor/Legends|locomotion system]], improved [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package, two [[Claw/Legends|claws]] with [[Limb/Legends|appendages]], two [[Plasma cutter/Legends|plasma cutters]], and two each of hand, instrument, and tool appendages. Although rarely used in assignments that involved directly attacking [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings, they were programmed to use their [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] cutters as weapons, and were capable of [[Death/Legends|killing]] or stunning living beings or droids in self-defense. At least one WSB-15 was physically identical to the [[WED-15 Septoid Treadwell/Legends|WED-15 Septoid Treadwell]]. That one had eight [[Manipulator arm/Legends|manipulator arms]], along with ten treaded [[wheel]]s at its base. It had [[Color/Legends|gray]] plating, with two red panels at the base above the treaded wheels, along with a pair of gray sensors.<ref name="Threats" />

==Role==
With the most effective WSB-15s being the ones nobody was aware of, most often one of the sabotage droids' owners would either deliberately damage a WED-15 Treadwell or simply wait for one to need repair or replacement. Repair [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] would be either waylaid or bribed by the WSB-15's owner, who would either substitute a WSB-15 for the broken WED-15 unit or remove the latter's processor core and replace it with that of a WSB-15. WSB-15s could be used to subtly reprogram a droid [[Factory/Legends|factory]], producing droids with personalities and training very different to the intended product.<ref name="Threats" />

Other roles for WSB-15s were creating serious malfunctions in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that only showed up in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] or engaging in wanton destruction sprees. Some WSB-15s would be programmed to continue performing sabotage up until they were discovered and then proceed to destroy themselves. In other cases, after completing their assignment, the WSB-15 would fake a minor malfunction that called for a repair crew, at which point the sabotage droid's owner would send agents to replace its processing core with that of a normal WED-15 unit, thus leaving sabotage victims unaware anything out of the ordinary had occurred.<ref name="Threats" />

==History==
[[WED-15-I7]] was a WSB-15 sabotage droid<ref name="Threats" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=WED15-I7 "Septoid" Droid}}</ref> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=WED15-I7 "Septoid" Droid}} is set around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of {{Film|IV}}, the events of which are dated to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> WED-15-I7 served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a fiercely loyal maintenance droid. It specialized in extending the effective operational life of Imperial resources.<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:WEDtreadwell-cvd.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The WSB-15 was created using an image of the WED-15 Septoid Treadwell.]]
The WSB-15 sabotage droid was created for WED-15-I7's card in the [[1996]] ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. The droid's appearance was identical to the WED-15 Septoid Treadwell, and it was described as a maintenance droid and nicknamed the "Septoid,"<ref name="CCG" /> which were both characteristics that applied to the WED-15 Septoid Treadwell.<ref name="FF2">{{FactFile|16|WED 1-4|WED Treadwell Repair Droid}}</ref> [[1998]]'s ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' would later directly identify WED-15-I7 as a Treadwell droid, while its image was separately used with a caption identifying it as a [[WED Treadwell repair droid/Legends|WED model droid]].<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[2002]]'s [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 16|16th issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine would also identify WED-15-I7 as a WED-15 Septoid Treadwell.<ref name="FF1">{{FactFile|16|WED 1-4|WED Treadwell Repair Droid}}</ref>

In [[March]] [[2008]], [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]'' first identified WED-15-I7 as a WSB-15 sabotage droid, coining the class name as well as contradicting previous materials.<ref name="Threats" /> On [[December 9]] of the same year,<ref name="release date">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20080926.html|text=Inside ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia''}}</ref> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' would again describe WED-15-I7 as a Septoid and a maintenance droid.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|324|WED-15-I7}}</ref> Because ''Threats of the Galaxy'' establishes the WSB-15's identical visual appearance to WED model droids and establishes its role in sabotage,<ref name="Threats" /> this article treats all the identifications of WED-15-I7 as a Septoid maintenance droid as [[canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, effectively as part of the sabotage droid's disguise.
